## Rule

Find all color-5 cells. Output the input crop with rows `min_row(5)-1 .. max_row(5)+1` and columns `min_col(5) .. max_col(5)`, preserving the 0/5/8 contents inside that rectangle. The model output is the usual 30x30 one-hot canvas with this variable crop placed at the top-left and all cells outside the crop all-zero.

## Algorithm sketch

```python
ys, xs = where(input == 5)
r0 = ys.min() - 1
r1 = ys.max() + 1
c0 = xs.min()
c1 = xs.max()
out = input[r0:r1 + 1, c0:c1 + 1]
```

## 2026-06-20 worker091 visual/generator notes

Preview + `GUI/client/public/tasks/task091.json` confirm the output size relation:
`H = max_row(5) - min_row(5) + 3`, `W = max_col(5) - min_col(5) + 1`, then embed that crop at the top-left of the standard 30x30 one-hot canvas with all-zero outside. Color 5 defines the crop rails; colors 0 and 8 are pass-through payload inside the crop. Two falsified alternatives: the crop is not the bbox of all color-8 cells, and it is not the color-5 bbox alone (it includes one row above and below the color-5 extent and preserves black cells inside).

Scratch formulations priced before v16 build:
- U8 bbox-reduce rewrite of v14: keep scalar Conv source, but compute row/column extrema from `idx_u8`; expected `2576 - (2*60 - 2*15) = 2486`. Built and staged as v16.
- Direct U8 source-plane Conv/QLinearConv: rejected for this graph because the official input is F32; `QLinearConv` would require a charged full-frame `Cast(input->U8)` (~9000 B), erasing the 900 B `idx_f` target.
- Move padding after one-hot Equal to delete scalar `canvas30`: rejected by existing floor math; the charged 10-channel crop is 1960 B versus the current 900 B scalar canvas.

Static ONNX v1 uses `SRC=15` for source reads and `OUT=14` for the top-left crop canvas. `OUT=14` is validated on the official 266 examples and cached 200k ARC-GEN corpus (`max_output=[14,14]`); `SRC=15` is still required because a valid 14-wide crop can read source index 14.

Current trustworthy floor is v13 static. It uses the same rule and keeps v10's internal encoding trick: original color 5 becomes scalar value 9, original color 8 stays 8, and final `Equal` ids decode internal 9 back to output channel 5. Unlike v10, v13 has fixed-shape 14x14 static gather and fixed 30x30 output even on `np.zeros((1,10,30,30))`.

## Cost analysis

Current/live 28,989 is dominated by moving all ten channels through the crop: `Slice [1,10,15,15] F32` (9,000) plus four `[1,10,15,15] F16` crop/shift/mask tensors (4,500 each). The ladder from there (v1 BOOL renderer 7245 → v2 scalar U8 color-index Equal-tail 4783 → v3–v5 Einsum/INT32/ArgMax bbox cleanup 3534 → v7–v10 dynamic exact Slice + internal value-9 encoding 2620 → v13 static sentinel floor 3274 → v14 dynamic INT32 geometry 2576 → **v16 2486**) is one row per rung in Attempts; **full per-version cost-analysis prose is archived at `Task_by_Task/_archive/task091_history.md`**.

v16 (current best, 2486) keeps v14's dynamic exact crop but moves `row_any`/`col_any` from F32 `idx_f` to U8 `idx_u8` (encoded gray=9 > azure=8, so U8 `ReduceMax` preserves the `ArgMax` extrema while shrinking the two bbox vectors from 60+60 B to 15+15 B). Current v16 dominant tensors:

| `idx_f` | 900 | F32 scalar source plane from Conv, still charged |

### 2026-07-08 worker1 — DEFINITIVE FLOOR PROOF (WALL @ 2486; prompt's ~800 est is infeasible)

Bar: live **2486** (manifest sha `872f4ce2…`, owner Boladi). Two forced 900-B planes; no strict-below graph exists. This supersedes/consolidates the W6 (2026-06-21) and GridSample (v17/v18) floor proofs — their route-specific kills live in the Attempts table + Don't-do.

**Scoring mechanics (`neurogolf_utils.calculate_memory`):** memory = Σ over every named node-output tensor (except literal `input`/`output`) of `num_elements × np.dtype(dtype).itemsize`; the graph `output` is free. **Min itemsize is 1 byte** — measured: UINT4/INT4/BOOL/UINT8 all charge itemsize=1 (numpy has no true nibble dtype). So no sub-byte packing exists.

**`canvas30` = 900 is a HARD floor.** The output `[1,10,30,30]` is produced free by `Equal(canvas30[1,1,30,30], ids[1,10,1,1])`. Equal broadcasts channel but cannot upsample H/W, so the pre-Equal plane must be full 30×30 → 30·30·1 = **900** for ANY dtype. Deleting it by expanding to 10 channels at the 14×14 crop then free-Pad (`tench_pad` probe) measures **3317** (Equal@14×14 = 1960 BOOL > 900) — worse.

**`idx_f` = 900 is forced.** The 10→1 channel combine (Conv) outputs F32 → 15·15·4 = 900 (SRC=15 required; a valid 14-wide crop reads source idx 14). Every alternative prices ≥900: ArgMax→INT64 = 1800; two per-channel F32 slices = 900 each; QLinearConv/ConvInteger need a U8 input = ~9000 Cast.

**Measured skeleton floor = 2258.** `probe_task091_floor.py` builds the bare selector-as-index core with a STATIC crop and ZERO bbox/geometry (`Conv→Cast→static Slice→Pad→Equal`): cost **2258** (idx_f 900 + idx_u8 225 + crop_u8 196 + canvas30 900 + params 37). This is the irreducible core **before any rule logic** → the prompt's ~800 est is infeasible by 2.8×. Current v16 (2486) sits only **228 B** above this floor; that 228 B is the forced dynamic rule (4× ArgMax INT64=32, INT32 arithmetic, dynamic Slice starts/ends=32, dynamic Pad INT64[8]=64, U8 bbox reduces=30) — each component at or near its own op-mandated floor.

**Verdict: WALL.** 2486 (v16) is the structural floor. The "fold selectors into a color-index Equal tail" lever the prompt names was already applied at v2 (7245→4783); there are no residual one-hot selector planes to delete.

## Don't-do log

_Record ruled-out hypotheses here so future agents don't retry them._
- Do not source-crop to 14x14. Official/corpus output max is 14x14, but a valid crop can read source index 14, so source masks must cover 15x15.
- Do not remove the upper-bound `Where` clamp before `Gather`. Inactive crop positions still execute `Gather`; without clamping, rows/cols past 14 crash with `idx=15`.
- Do not compute height as `y1_5 - (y0_5 - 1) + 1`; the correct crop height is `y1_5 - y0_5 + 3`. The off-by-one variant scored 0/266 visible.
- Do not omit channel 0 inside the crop. The official path thresholds the full one-hot tensor and compares it to `convert_to_numpy`, so zero cells inside the expected crop require channel-0 positives.
- Do not stage an unannotated dynamic Slice/Pad graph. v6_dynamic_slice was 266/266 official but `score_network_v2` rejected it and real-input profile returned `None`.
- Do not replace the scalar `Pad -> Equal` tail with a 10-channel one-hot crop at `OUT=14`; the one-hot crop costs 1,960 bytes versus the fixed 900-byte scalar canvas.
- Do not assume nibble-packing the color-index plane helps here. The plane has only one value consumer, and the unpack path for exact 14-wide output is expected to cost more than the 420-byte F32/U8 source-plane saving.
- Do not keep separate color-5 Einsum marginals after v10. Encoding color 5 as internal scalar 9 lets the existing source plane provide bbox supports at 60+60 bytes and 40 fewer params.
- Do not treat v10's 2,620 as the shippable floor. Its zero dummy returns `[1,10,14,30]`, so it is a dynamic-output probe. v13 at 3,274 is the clean fixed-shape sibling.
- Do not treat v14's 2,576 as a clean static crop-tail result. It is annotated and gate-clean on real inputs, but it retains the v10-class scorer-dummy output-shape warning.
- Do not pursue the free-output SEPARABLE Einsum crop (`Einsum('bchw,hH,wW->bcHW',...)`) for this task (v15, KILLED — measured F32-sel 11,797 / F16-sel 26,199; see Attempts v15 row for the full structural why). Both selectors are irreducibly `[30,30]` and the 10-ch one-hot forces an F32 carrier, so the selector floor is 7,200 B >> the gather tail. The separable-Einsum lever wins only when selectors replace a build-chain larger than themselves; here the slice tail is already cheaper than any `[30,30]` selector pair.
- Do not retry direct `QLinearConv` U8 source-plane emission from the F32 graph input unless a cheap U8 feed already exists. ORT requires U8/INT8 input for `QLinearConv`; casting the full one-hot input costs about 9,000 B to target the 900 B `idx_f`.
- Do not chase sub-1000 / killing both 900-B blockers (W6 2026-06-21 floor proof, above). `idx_f` (15x15 F32 Conv source plane) and `canvas30` (30x30 U8 pre-Equal canvas) are BOTH documented architectural floors (`cost_floor_reference.md` canvas-900 law + Conv->F32 plane taxonomy). The crop is 14x14 so the canvas-elimination crossover (one-hot crop beats 900 U8 canvas only when h*w<90) does NOT fire (1960>900). ArgMax/Cast/MatMul/QLinearConv source-plane alternatives all price >=900 or far worse. 2486 (v16) is the floor; no strict-below candidate exists.
- Do not chase sub-byte packing (UINT4/INT4/nibble) to shrink `canvas30` or `idx_u8` (worker1 2026-07-08). The grader charges `num_elements × np.dtype(dtype).itemsize` and min itemsize is 1 byte — UINT4/INT4/BOOL/UINT8 all measure itemsize=1. So a 30×30 scalar plane is 900 in ANY dtype; there is no packed dtype the grader prices below 1 B/elem. The measured zero-geometry skeleton floor is 2258 (`probe_task091_floor.py`); the prompt's ~800 est is infeasible.
- Do not re-attempt the GridSample-crop (#121) for this task (W11/W13, v17 lower-bound 5,979 and corrected v18 6,146 vs v16 2,486). GridSample is float-only on ORT CPU, so it still requires a float source plane (does NOT delete `idx_f` 900), and the final Equal still needs `canvas30` 900 (the "free Pad" never deletes it). Worse, GridSample ADDS its own charged tail: an F16 coord grid `[1,14,14,2]`=784 plus the grid-build planes (`xfull/yfull/xg/yg`=4x392) — all sized by the 14x14 crop. Correctness also needs either exact slicing or an H/W mask after the static 14x14 sample. Per the #109 selector-vs-crop byte law (techniques.md L4210) GridSample-crop only wins when the grid is small (task351 k=5 → 200-B grid); here k=14 makes the grid+build-chain the dominant cost. The v16 dynamic Slice/Pad tail (~292 B) is far cheaper than any GridSample grid for this crop size.
